[FMLA 09] RCVoltage — RC Series Terminal Voltage of R

Resistor terminal voltage VR in an RC series circuit after a DC voltage V is applied (exponential decay).

Calculator scroll name: RCVoltage. This is the voltage across the resistor R at time t after DC voltage V is applied to a series RC circuit — not the capacitor charging voltage.

formula
VR​=Ve−t/(CR)

At the instant the switch closes, all of V is across R. Current then dies away as the capacitor fills, so VR falls toward 0. The time unit is RC (resistance × capacitance).

keys
FMLA→0→9

Primary inputs: V, R, C, t.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 0, then 9 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

At t = 0, VR = V
At t = RC, VR ≈ 0.37 V
At t = 5 RC, VR ≈ 0.007 V
note

Use SI: R in Ω, C in F, t in seconds, V and VR in volts. Official constraints: C, R, t > 0.
